figures.finding: Since 1 July 2016 Norfolk Island is part of Australia for income tax: the island's residents' exemption (Division 1A of Part III of the 1936 Act) was repealed and Australian income tax and the Medicare levy apply as on the mainland.
figures.applies: Norfolk Island residents and income; every income-tax, social (super guarantee), withholding, non-resident and authors figure is Australia's.

sources.said: 2 Commencement This Act commences on 1 July 2016.
Schedule 1—Income tax (including the Medicare levy) Income Tax Assessment Act 1936 1 Division 1A of Part III Repeal the Division.

Australia means the Commonwealth of Australia and, when used in a geographical sense, includes Norfolk Island, the Territory of Christmas Island and the Territory of Cocos (Keeling) Islands, but does not include any other external Territory.

figures.finding: Australian GST does not reach Norfolk Island: the GST Act's indirect tax zone excludes the external Territories, so a freelancer's fee there bears no GST.
figures.applies: Supplies made on Norfolk Island (an external Territory).
